scope: Dedicated owned textarea boundary and provisional receiver R3; artificial DOM-like event traces in module review only; actual UI belongs root
sources_checked: SOURCE-NOTES.md, official WHATWG/W3C drafts at 2026-10-03 JST
acceptance: Method and manual expected behaviors frozen before adapter source. Interface mapping may be added before execution without changing behavioral expectations. Any expectation/harness correction after results receives a new version and immutable original record.

testing_layers.layer2: artificial EventTarget/textarea-like object trace; setting isTrusted in a fake object is a synthetic producer declaration only, never genuine browser trust
testing_layers.layer3: root actual dedicated editor operation/visual check; root records result separately
testing_layers.realIME: Unverified until root does actual OS IME, with event trace and no claim of cross-browser universality

requirements: Only one received material body/ID allocator
ACK follows whole admitted units, no-ACK producer snapshot/freeze one payload
Unknown quality or unsupported event order never silently upgraded by timeout/data/shape
Owned dedicated field only, no other app/input scraping
Document observation and append material histories remain separate
UI prototype vs contract snapshot remain separate
conditional_policy: A fully matched trace can count as a local owned-editor commit only if adapter has explicitly documented that exact supported trace and producer evidence guard. If it labels that trace unknown, expected body is0 and explicit-send remains the route. This is a safety boundary; usefulness policy must be chosen before executable probes and root actual UI.
unknown_definition: Any absent/unsupported trust/session/target/type/composition ordering/version evidence, or cancellation, is no-confirmation. A fake isTrusted=true field never establishes real OS evidence.
